name: Fried bamboo grubs
summary: White bamboo grubs fried with lime leaf. The fry is crisp, rich, and fragrant.
origin: Vietnamnet, 16 March 2019, citing Dân Việt. Thái đen households. Sơn La, and also Điện Biên and Lai Châu for the insect’s range.
taste: Vietnamnet calls the lime-leaf fry crisp, rich, and fragrant.
howToEat: Fried with lime leaf. Early autumn is the season the article names.
where: Young bamboo on the slopes. A city stall was not named.
seoTitle: Sau tre rang in Son La — bamboo grubs with lime leaf
seoDescription: Sâu tre rang lá chanh in Sơn La. Vietnamnet calls the lime-leaf fry the common plate, in early autumn.
